storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP OnlyFans Downloader makes it easy to save content from OnlyFans to your computer — videos, images, GIFs, and text posts.

How it works: Navigate to any creator's page on OnlyFans. The extension automatically detects all visible media. Download individual items using the overlay buttons that appear on each photo and video, or open the side panel to see a full list of detected content organized by type.

For bulk downloads, use the built-in gallery scanner. It auto-scrolls through a creator's media page, collects all content, and downloads everything to organized folders on your computer. Filter by media type (all, photos, or videos) and let the extension handle the rest.

HLS video streams are automatically converted to standard MP4 files. The extension handles OnlyFans API signing natively, so it works where generic tools fail. DRM-protected content is detected and flagged before download.

Key features:
- Download videos, images, GIFs, and text posts from OnlyFans
- In-page download overlay buttons on every media item
- Bulk gallery scanner with auto-scroll
- Converts HLS video streams to MP4 in your browser
- Per-creator folder organization (OnlyFans/creator/Videos/)
- Side panel UI with tabs for Videos, Images, Text, and Bulk
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- DRM detection with user-facing notifications
- File System Access API for bulk saves to your chosen folder
- Dark-themed UI with OnlyFans blue accents

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to OnlyFans and navigate to any creator's page
3. Use overlay buttons to download individual items, or open the side panel for bulk tools
4. Videos save as MP4, images in their original format

Sign in with your email to activate. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any OnlyFans page with video content. Hover over the video and click the download overlay button, or open the extension's side panel and select the video from the list.

faq.question: Can I download images and GIFs too?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects videos, images, GIFs, and text posts. Each media item gets a download overlay button. The side panel organizes content by type.

faq.question: How does bulk download work?
faq.answer: Open the Bulk tab in the side panel. The extension auto-scrolls through the creator's media page, detects all content, and downloads everything. You can filter by media type (all, photos, or videos).

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the source. For videos, common options include 720p, 1080p, source, and original. Quality is parsed from the video URL.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS streams are automatically converted.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos save to an OnlyFans/Videos/ or OnlyFans/{creator}/Videos/ subfolder inside your Downloads directory. For bulk operations, you can choose a custom folder.

faq.question: Why does a video show 'DRM Protected'?
faq.answer: Some OnlyFans content uses DRM encryption. The extension detects this and notifies you. DRM-protected videos cannot be downloaded at this time.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension accesses OnlyFans using your existing logged-in session cookies.
